definitions.gloss: marriage registration form; notification of marriage
definitions.explanation: The official document submitted to a local government office to legally register a marriage in Japan. Submitting this form is what makes a marriage legally valid — no ceremony is required.

examples.japanese: {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To submit a marriage registration form.

examples.japanese: {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{証人|しょうにん}→証人：18845_shounin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: Two witnesses are needed for a marriage registration form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{記念日|きねんび}→記念日：05585_kinenbi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{市役所|しやくしょ}→市役所：03067_shiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}し→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The two went to the city hall to submit their marriage registration form on their anniversary.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{婚姻|こんいん}→婚姻：12244_konin⟧ (marriage) and {届|とどけ} (notification/report). In Japan, marriage becomes legal when this form is accepted at a municipal office — no wedding ceremony is legally required. The form requires signatures from the couple and two adult witnesses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to submit a marriage registration
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧: to submit a marriage registration (formal)
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受理|じゅり}→受理：12032_juri⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: the marriage registration is accepted
- {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|か}き{方|かた}→書き方：13054_kakikata⟧: how to fill out a marriage registration

CULTURAL NOTE:
Many couples choose a meaningful date to submit their {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}, such as a holiday, anniversary, or auspicious day. Some municipal offices accept forms 24 hours a day. Recently, some municipalities offer decorative {婚姻届|こんいんとどけ} designs featuring local characters or landmarks.

RELATED WORDS:
- {離婚届|りこんとどけ}: divorce registration form
- {出生届|しゅっしょうとどけ}: birth registration form
- ⟦{入籍|にゅうせき}→入籍：19149_nyuuseki⟧: entering the family register — often used colloquially as a synonym for getting legally married
